reviews.text: I had a large maple tree stump I could not get out by myself so I called for assistance and left a message. Tom, from Mill and Grind, called me back and coordinated a date and time with me. He showed up at my home early, ready to work.
reviews.author: Anthony G.

reviews.text: Tom from Mill & Grind was extremely helpful with helping me remove my stumps and planting grass where my trees were. His communication was great as well as his price. I won’t even shop around next time I need a stump ground. Five stars!
reviews.author: Cody B.

reviews.text: We appreciate Mill & Grind LLC's prompt service in removing our tree stumps. If you require stump grinding services, we highly recommend Mill & Grind LLC for their exceptional customer service, expertise, and professionalism. Mill & Grind LLC.
reviews.author: Tammy K.
